description: Conditionals use PHP truthiness: "" and "0" are the only falsey strings, 0 is falsey, empty lists are falsey, a group with fields is truthy even when every field is empty. @if over a list is rejected; use @each.

cases.name: Empty string is falsey
String "0" is falsey
String "0.0" is truthy
String "false" is truthy
Whitespace is truthy
Number 0 is falsey
Numeric string "0" for a Number is falsey
Number 0.5 is truthy
Negative numbers are truthy
Boolean true is truthy
Boolean "1" is truthy
Empty repeater is falsey
Repeater with rows is truthy and iterates
Group with fields is truthy even when every field is empty
Group with a value renders its field
@if over a list is rejected; @each iterates lists
